user.title: BG Smart Local Control
user.description:
Connect to a BG Smart device (dimmer or smart socket) on your local network.

Devices are normally discovered automatically. Use this form if yours was not found.

data_description.host: IP address of your BG Smart device (e.g., 192.168.1.100)
data_description.node_id: Optional. The device's hostname as shown in your router's client list (e.g. C3GNXiRBoiyPb5p5mGzHtZ). If set, the integration follows the device when its IP address changes.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to device. Check the IP address and port.
error.not_bg_device: The device responded but does not look like a BG Smart dimmer or socket.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the discovered device
abort.not_bg_device: Discovered device is not a BG Smart dimmer or socket
